description: The Disaster Recovery Transparency Portal of Puerto Rico's Central Office for Reconstruction, Recovery and Resiliency (COR3) reports on the federally funded rebuilding of the island after the hurricanes of 2017, the 2020 earthquakes and the pandemic. The portal read on 2026-09-28 says it is updated weekly (last on 23 September 2026) with information on recovery programmes, and has sections on disasters, programmes, the road to recovery, finances, requests for proposals and contracts, and documents; it features individual projects with their obligated federal amounts, such as USD 16.5 million for the La Plata Dam of the Puerto Rico Aqueduct and Sewer Authority. Coverage is Puerto Rico, by disaster, programme, municipality and applicant. Access is free on the web; no licence or bulk download is stated. Caveats: amounts are obligations and disbursements, not physical progress, and project details depend on how agencies enter them. It supports recovery and restoration studies of water, power, road and public buildings after major hurricanes, such as reconstruction costs and timelines by asset type. No related Puerto Rico recovery record is catalogued; FEMA Public Assistance open data complement it.
